Prepare step by step

  1. Verify location, credentials, accepting-patient status and insurance directly.
  2. Ask about accessibility, language, after-hours support and referral processes.
  3. Prepare a private medication, history and question list.
  4. Choose independently; directory appearance and paid status are not endorsements.
